verdict.rationale: Digits documents an official hosted MCP server at https://api.digits.com/mcp. Setup uses OAuth against the user's own account with no API keys, and instructions are published for Claude Desktop (an official Claude Connector), Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor and Perplexity. A live probe confirms an auth-gated remote MCP endpoint with RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata, matching the MCP authorization spec. Missing for 10: write or action capabilities (the server is explicitly read-only), and independent hands-on evidence of real agent sessions using its tools beyond the auth handshake probe.
